Unusual day a friendly note for busy families
Please read this before you travel
Travel notice for animal passengers

Travelers need to know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways will review each animal care request with attention and calm. We ask you to share the facts that help us plan a safe and comfortable journey for the animal and for the people traveling with it.

Our records aide notes that a welfare coordinator reviews comfort needs before travel, and the care plan is matched to the animal's species, temperament, and usual routine. <<FACT F057>> If a traveler is worried, supervisors will listen carefully and help guide the next step with respect and patience.

Please keep carriers, leads, and travel papers ready for check-in, and arrive prepared to follow the instructions given at the desk. The team will look at comfort, handling, and space needs so that the journey can proceed in an orderly way.

For help with animal travel arrangements, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
